message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and I couldn't help but chuckle at my own gloriously over-prepared self. I had a stash of flashlights, lanterns, and even a portable power bank ready to go! While my neighbors were rummaging through drawers for old candles, I was cozy in my living room, streaming a movie on my phone while enjoying some snacks from my cooler. It’s moments like these that remind me how nice it is to be a little ahead of the game. What’s your favorite tip for staying comfy during an outage?
